verdicts.reason: Both turn the dark header bar into a big empty black block in the top-left. The Q logo shrinks to an illegible speck inside it, so the brand is effectively lost. The over-long headline is crammed into a narrow right column, and the body copy, CTA, 'Ships late June' and legal text are jammed together at the bottom with almost no spacing. A's 'Reserve a Case' button is tiny and gets lost, though it keeps the orange divider and a slight right margin. B's larger button gives a clearer call to action, but its headline runs almost to the right edge, the divider is gone and the body copy butts straight against the headline.
